mapper.sql: -- 适用对象一律取源课程 education_level course.education_level AS education_level, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sm.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tcs ON tcs.course_id = c2.id INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON ts.id = tcs.scheme_id AND ts.sysflag = 0 LEFT JOIN t_csys_std_major sm ON sm.id = ts.major_id WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND ts.major_id IS NOT NULL), (SELECT sm.name FROM t_csys_std_major sm WHERE sm.id = course.major_Id)) AS major_name, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.course_attr SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_attr IS NOT NULL AND c2.course_attr != ''), course.course_attr) AS course_attr, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.course_Module SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_Module IS NOT NULL AND c2.course_Module != ''), course.course_Module) AS course_module

COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tcs.term ORDER BY tcs.term SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tcs ON tcs.course_id = c2.id INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON ts.id = tcs.scheme_id AND ts.sysflag = 0 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND tcs.term IS NOT NULL), course.open_term) AS term
mapper.select:
SELECT course.id AS course_id, course.name AS course_name, course.code AS course_code, course.college_id AS college_id, course.education_level AS education_level, course.course_Module AS course_module, course.course_Module_Children AS course_module_children, course.course_attr AS course_attr, course.type AS course_type, course.version AS version, course.program_Level AS program_level, course.sub_Major_Id AS sub_major_id, course.major_Id AS major_id, NULL AS major_name, course.hours AS hours, course.credit AS credit, plan.id AS teaching_plan_id, plan.plan_type AS plan_type, plan.version AS plan_version, plan.current_flag AS current_flag, plan.enabled_term AS enabled_term, plan.status AS status, plan.file_id AS file_id, plan.file_name AS file_name, plan.source_credit AS source_credit, plan.score_rule AS score_rule FROM t_csys_course course LEFT JOIN t_csys_teaching_plan plan ON course.id = plan.source_course_id AND plan.sysflag = 0 AND plan.current_flag = 1
course.source_id IS NULL AND course.sysflag = 0
AND course.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND course.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseCode}, '%')
AND course.college_id = #{collegeId}
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_csys_course c2 INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tcs ON tcs.course_id = c2.id INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON ts.id = tcs.scheme_id AND ts.sysflag = 0 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND ts.education_level = #{educationLevel}) OR course.education_level = #{educationLevel})
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_Module = #{courseModule}) OR course.course_Module = #{courseModule})
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_attr = #{courseAttr}) OR course.course_attr = #{courseAttr})
AND course.type IN (1, 3)
AND course.type = #{type}
AND course.version = #{version}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0)
ORDER BY course.id DESC

SELECT c2.source_id AS courseId, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(c2.course_Module, '') SEPARATOR '、') AS courseModule, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(c2.location, '') SEPARATOR '、') AS location FROM t_csys_course c2 LEFT JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tcs ON tcs.course_id = c2.id WHERE c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.source_id = #{sourceCourseId} GROUP BY c2.source_id

SELECT course.id AS course_id, NULL AS teaching_plan_id, course.name AS course_name, course.code AS course_code, course.en_name AS course_en_name, NULL AS source_course_en_name, course.type AS course_type, course.version AS enabled_term, , , course.major_Id AS major_id, course.teach_hours AS teach_hours, course.practice_hours AS practice_hours, course.hours AS hours, course.credit AS credit, NULL AS score_rule FROM t_csys_course course WHERE course.id = #{courseId} AND course.sysflag = 0

SELECT plan.source_course_id AS course_id, plan.id AS teaching_plan_id, course.name AS course_name, course.code AS course_code,
plan.source_course_en_name AS course_en_name, course.type AS course_type, course.version AS enabled_term, , , course.major_Id AS major_id, course.teach_hours AS teach_hours, course.practice_hours AS practice_hours, course.hours AS hours, course.credit AS credit, plan.score_rule AS score_rule FROM t_csys_teaching_plan plan INNER JOIN t_csys_course course ON course.id = plan.source_course_id AND course.sysflag = 0 WHERE plan.id = #{teachingPlanId} AND plan.sysflag = 0

SELECT sc.id AS course_id, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.course_attr SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = sc.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_attr IS NOT NULL AND c2.course_attr != ''), sc.course_attr) AS course_attr_raw, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tcs.term ORDER BY tcs.term SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tcs ON tcs.course_id = c2.id INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON ts.id = tcs.scheme_id AND ts.sysflag = 0 WHERE c2.source_id = sc.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND tcs.term IS NOT NULL) AS term_raw FROM t_csys_course sc WHERE sc.sysflag = 0 AND sc.id IN
#{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sc.id AS courseId, c2.time_Week AS timeWeek, c2.unit AS unit FROM t_csys_course sc INNER JOIN t_csys_course c2 ON c2.source_id = sc.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 WHERE sc.sysflag = 0 AND (c2.time_Week IS NOT NULL OR c2.unit IS NOT NULL) AND sc.id IN
#{id}
